summary: Steakholder Foods filed a Form 6-K attaching a Rule 424(b) prospectus supplement dated October 5, 2026, increasing to $4,036,262 the aggregate offering price of American Depositary Shares sellable under its August 1, 2024 At-the-Market Offering Agreement with H.C. Wainwright & Co., LLC. Each ADS represents 12,000 ordinary shares. Sales occur off the April 2025 Form F-3 shelf (File No. 333-286445), already declared effective, with Meitar Law Offices furnishing the Israeli-law validity opinion. This is a routine shelf takedown capacity update, not a special situation; there is no fixed price, premium, board recommendation or closing date. Watch dilution pace, ADS ratio mechanics and any trading overhang from future at-the-market sales.
